course_name_original: Competências Transversais para a Eletrotécnia e Computadores
course_name_en: Transversal Competences for Electrical and Computer Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with information on the various specific areas in which electrotechnical and computer engineering is broken down and their associated career opportunities.
Provide students with some transversal skills relevant to their evaluation along their academic path.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the main areas of Electrical and Computer Engineering intervention
Bibliographic research methods and information analysis in science and technology
teaching_methods: Lectures with working group for the development of transversal skills
Seminars for presentation of main areas of electrical and computer engineering
bibliography: Support materials provided by the teacher
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
